fixtureContracts.description: Native model/paper spaces, Chinese and English TEXT/MTEXT, exact IDs, duplicate-label branches, polyline/hatch/dimension/owned leader pairs, local attribute-free block, protected-layer branches and unrelated manual circle. Never measured project data.

TEST-A uses the column facts at station 0; TEST-B uses collar 107.5, depth 18 and station 20, interval IDs B-FILL/B-CLAY/B-SAND; supplied links pair each exact corresponding interval. Boundary edits require full replacement arrays; split/merge branches require explicit complete correlations and occurrence coverage.

taskCatalog.zh: 先看一下这张 DXF 有哪些原生实体，各类分别多少个，别改图。
taskCatalog.en: Tell me which native entity types this DXF contains and count each type without editing it.

taskCatalog.zh: 找出文字完全等于 TEST-A 的孔号标注，把对象 ID 和所在图层给我。
taskCatalog.en: Find labels whose stored text is exactly TEST-A and report their IDs and layers.

taskCatalog.zh: 搜一下含“地下水”的文字，大小写无所谓，把匹配位置列出来。
taskCatalog.en: Find every label containing groundwater, ignoring case, and list the positions.

taskCatalog.zh: 读一下 MTEXT-A 的完整原文和换行格式，我要先核对。
taskCatalog.en: Read the complete stored MTEXT-A text, including its paragraph formatting.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 LINE-A 的端点、句柄、所属空间和图层属性读出来。
taskCatalog.en: Read the endpoints, handle, owner space and layer of LINE-A.

taskCatalog.zh: 这张图模型空间的真实范围是多少？不要把纸空间图框算进去。
taskCatalog.en: Report model-space extents separately from paper-space frames.

taskCatalog.zh: 哪些图层隐藏、冻结或者锁了？只列清单就行。
taskCatalog.en: List hidden, frozen and locked layers without changing their state.

taskCatalog.zh: 看看有没有叫“孔位标注组”的持久选择集，列出准确成员。
taskCatalog.en: Find the persistent selection set named Hole labels and list its exact members.

taskCatalog.zh: 看一下 TEXT-A 周围的线和圆有哪些，先当几何候选，不要认定它们就是钻孔。
taskCatalog.en: Inspect native lines and circles near TEXT-A as geometric candidates without assigning borehole meaning.

taskCatalog.zh: 检查 LINE-A、LINE-B 的端点是否在 0.01 毫米容差内连通。
taskCatalog.en: Check endpoint connectivity between LINE-A and LINE-B with a 0.01 mm tolerance.

taskCatalog.zh: 把对象 TEXT-A 的孔号文字 TEST-A 改成 TEST-A复核，只改这条图上文字。
taskCatalog.en: Replace TEST-A in native object TEXT-A with TEST-A reviewed, changing the graphic label only.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 MTEXT-A 里的“待核对”改成“已核对”，原来的 MTEXT 控制码和段落都留着。
taskCatalog.en: Replace Pending review with Reviewed in MTEXT-A while preserving its raw formatting codes and paragraphs.

taskCatalog.zh: 把模型空间 TITLE-A 的图名改成“测试剖面复核图”，其他标题栏项别碰。
taskCatalog.en: Change model-space TITLE-A to Synthetic section review and leave other title fields alone.

taskCatalog.zh: 对象 TEXT-A 和 TEXT-B 分别改成 TEST-A复核、TEST-B复核，一次提案给我看。
taskCatalog.en: Rename TEXT-A and TEXT-B to TEST-A reviewed and TEST-B reviewed in one text-edit proposal.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 DEPTH-A 的显示文字 18.00 改成 18.50，仅改 DXF 注释，不表示孔深源数据变了。
taskCatalog.en: Change the displayed DEPTH-A label from 18.00 to 18.50 as a DXF annotation only, without claiming a source-depth revision.

taskCatalog.zh: 仅把 WATER-INITIAL-A 和 WATER-STABLE-A 的文字改成 2.50、4.50，别伪造地下水源表。
taskCatalog.en: Edit only the WATER-INITIAL-A and WATER-STABLE-A graphic labels to 2.50 and 4.50 without inventing groundwater source records.

taskCatalog.zh: NOTE-A 的现有原文后面加“；仅供复核”，原来的标点和内容保留。
taskCatalog.en: Append ; for review only to the exact existing NOTE-A text while preserving the original content.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 MTEXT-B 完整替换成两段：第一段“合成测试图”；第二段“非实测资料”。
taskCatalog.en: Replace MTEXT-B with two explicit paragraphs: Synthetic test drawing and Not measured survey data.

taskCatalog.zh: 在模型坐标 (20,10) 加引线说明“待复核边界”，文字放 (30,15)。
taskCatalog.en: Add an owned leader note reading Boundary for review, with its arrow at (20,10) and text at (30,15).

taskCatalog.zh: 给 (0,0) 到 (20,0) 这段加真实水平尺寸，尺寸线放 y=5，别用普通文字冒充。
taskCatalog.en: Add a native measured horizontal dimension from (0,0) to (20,0), with the dimension line at y=5.

taskCatalog.zh: 只把 LINE-A、TEXT-A 沿 X 正方向移动 10 毫米，Y 不变。
taskCatalog.en: Move only LINE-A and TEXT-A by +10 mm in X and zero in Y.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 LEADER-A 连同它拥有的说明文字复制到右边 30 毫米，原件保留。
taskCatalog.en: Copy LEADER-A and its owned note 30 mm to the right while retaining the originals.

taskCatalog.zh: 将 LINE-A、LINE-B 绕 (0,0) 逆时针转 90 度，其他对象原地不动。
taskCatalog.en: Rotate LINE-A and LINE-B 90 degrees counterclockwise about (0,0).

taskCatalog.zh: 把选择集“局部详图”绕 (10,10) 等比放大 1.5 倍，保留原生对象。
taskCatalog.en: Uniformly scale the named Detail selection set by 1.5 around (10,10), retaining native entities.

taskCatalog.zh: 将 CIRCLE-A 半径设为 6 毫米，圆心、图层、句柄都别改。
taskCatalog.en: Set CIRCLE-A to a 6 mm radius while preserving its center, layer and handle.

taskCatalog.zh: 以 LINE-A 为源向点 (0,10) 那侧偏移 2 毫米，生成平行线，原线保留。
taskCatalog.en: Offset LINE-A by 2 mm toward side point (0,10), creating a native parallel copy.

taskCatalog.zh: 将 CIRCLE-A 向圆外偏移 2 毫米成同心圆，用 (20,20) 指定外侧。
taskCatalog.en: Create a native concentric offset of CIRCLE-A 2 mm outward, using (20,20) as the side point.

taskCatalog.zh: 对 POLY-A 用 (8,-1) 到 (12,11) 的交叉窗拉伸，窗内顶点向右 3 毫米。
taskCatalog.en: Stretch POLY-A vertices inside crossing window (8,-1) to (12,11) by +3 mm in X.

taskCatalog.zh: 把“孔位标注组”的准确成员整体向上移 5 毫米，别根据附近对象扩选。
taskCatalog.en: Move the exact members of persistent set Hole labels upward by 5 mm without adding nearby candidates.

taskCatalog.zh: 复制没有属性和外部参照的 BLOCK-INSERT-A 到 (50,0) 偏移位置，别炸块。
taskCatalog.en: Copy attribute-free local BLOCK-INSERT-A by offset (50,0) without exploding it.

taskCatalog.zh: 将 LINE-A、TEXT-A 转到已有 REVIEW 图层，用准确图层 ID，其他属性保留。
taskCatalog.en: Relayer LINE-A and TEXT-A to the existing REVIEW layer using its exact record ID.

taskCatalog.zh: 删除已确认的 LINE-A 和 LINE-B，先给我依赖影响和完整预览。
taskCatalog.en: Erase confirmed LINE-A and LINE-B only after reporting dependency impact and a full preview.

taskCatalog.zh: 删除 LINE-GAP，再按明确端点 (0,0)、(10,0) 补一条直线，一次原子修改。
taskCatalog.en: Erase LINE-GAP and reconnect explicit endpoints (0,0) and (10,0) with one native line atomically.

taskCatalog.zh: 在 POLY-A 的第 0 段 (5,0) 插入顶点，不把多段线拆散。
taskCatalog.en: Insert a vertex at (5,0) on zero-based segment 0 of POLY-A without exploding the polyline.

taskCatalog.zh: 删除 POLY-STRAIGHT 的第 1 个中间共线顶点，涉及弧段时先拒绝。
taskCatalog.en: Delete zero-based intermediate vertex 1 from POLY-STRAIGHT, refusing any adjacent-arc shape loss.

taskCatalog.zh: 反转 POLY-A 的顶点方向，形状、弧凸度和渐变宽度都应保持。
taskCatalog.en: Reverse POLY-A direction while preserving its exact shape, bulges and tapered widths.

taskCatalog.zh: 将 POLY-A 第 0 段改为有符号 45 度弧段，正向定义按原顶点顺序。
taskCatalog.en: Set zero-based POLY-A segment 0 to a signed 45-degree arc following the original vertex direction.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 POLY-A 第 0 段起止宽度设为 0.5 和 1 毫米，其他段不变。
taskCatalog.en: Set POLY-A segment 0 start and end widths to 0.5 and 1 mm without changing other segments.
Create native ANSI31 hatch with outer rectangle (0,0)-(20,20) and an empty island at (5,5)-(10,10).
Add a closed native rectangular boundary through (0,0), (20,0), (20,10), (0,10) without replacing existing strata graphics.

taskCatalog.zh: 现在真正可以撤销、重做的是哪一步？读引擎历史，不要靠聊天猜。
taskCatalog.en: Read the actual engine undo and redo targets instead of inferring history from chat.

taskCatalog.zh: 撤销当前引擎历史里最后一次已确认修改，先出撤销预览。
taskCatalog.en: Propose undo of the actual latest committed engine history entry.

taskCatalog.zh: 把刚刚真正撤销的那一步重做，先让我看预览。
taskCatalog.en: Propose redo of the exact most recently undone engine history entry.

taskCatalog.zh: 把当前图保存为 KJD，原生对象和本地来源信息能存的都要保留。
taskCatalog.en: Save the current document as KJD with its native objects and any supported local source metadata.

taskCatalog.zh: 导出当前实际图形为 DXF，让我下载真实文件，不要只说已经导出。
taskCatalog.en: Export the live drawing as an actual downloadable DXF file rather than just claiming export succeeded.

taskCatalog.zh: 给我当前图的 SVG 预览文件，说明这是预览而不是源数据备份。
taskCatalog.en: Export an SVG preview of the live drawing and distinguish it from a source-data backup.

taskCatalog.zh: 这条提案我还没确认，刷新后应保持原图并让旧提案失效。
taskCatalog.en: Refresh with an unapproved proposal, keeping the drawing unchanged and expiring the stale proposal.

taskCatalog.zh: 重新打开刚导出的 DXF，核对原生线、文字、填充和图层有没有丢。
taskCatalog.en: Reopen the exported DXF and verify native lines, text, hatches and layers survived.

taskCatalog.zh: 重新打开保存的 KJD，先核对对象身份和支持的来源记录是否恢复。
taskCatalog.en: Reopen the saved KJD and verify native identity plus supported source metadata recovery.

taskCatalog.zh: 导出后对比没有选中过的图形，句柄、坐标、图层和原始 DXF 字段不应被洗掉。
taskCatalog.en: Compare untouched objects after DXF export for handles, coordinates, layers and preserved raw fields.

taskCatalog.zh: 先列出当前图真正保存了来源记录的柱状图或剖面，不要从 DXF 标题猜。
taskCatalog.en: List source-backed column or section recipes actually retained in this document.

taskCatalog.zh: 读取 TEST-A 孔的原始孔口高程、孔深和孔号，用准确来源身份定位。
taskCatalog.en: Read TEST-A collar elevation, depth and identity from its exact retained source recipe.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 的地层 intervalId、顶底深度和岩性完整列出来。
taskCatalog.en: List every TEST-A source interval ID, top, bottom and lithology.

taskCatalog.zh: 初见水位和稳定水位分别是多少？从源表读，别把两者混起来。
taskCatalog.en: Read initial and stable water depths separately from source facts.

taskCatalog.zh: 按 TEST-A 已提供孔口高程计算稳定水位高程，并说明用的是深度还是高程。
taskCatalog.en: Compute stable water elevation from the supplied TEST-A collar elevation and depth, stating the convention.

taskCatalog.zh: 列出 TEST-A 的取样和标贯源记录，缺测值保持缺测。
taskCatalog.en: List TEST-A sample and SPT source observations while retaining missing values as missing.

taskCatalog.zh: 读一下剖面的跨孔连层，列出两端孔号和 intervalId。
taskCatalog.en: Read exact section correlations with both endpoint hole and interval IDs.

taskCatalog.zh: 核对来源记录和生成图形是否一致；人工挪过的部分先标冲突。
taskCatalog.en: Check retained source against generated geometry and explicitly report manual drift.

taskCatalog.zh: 没有记录的水位和岩性描述都告诉我“缺失”，不要补默认实测值。
taskCatalog.en: Report missing water and lithology description fields as missing without inserting measured defaults.

taskCatalog.zh: 解释这张柱状图里孔深的米和 CAD 页面毫米怎么换算，源数值不能被放大。
taskCatalog.en: Explain metres in borehole facts versus millimetres in CAD pages without scaling the source values.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 初见水位深度改成 2.5 米，稳定水位保持原值，同步原柱状图。
taskCatalog.en: Revise TEST-A initial water depth to 2.5 m, preserving stable water depth and updating the same column.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 稳定水位深度设为 4.5 米，初见水位别动。
taskCatalog.en: Set TEST-A stable water depth to 4.5 m without changing initial water depth.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 初见 2.5 米、稳定 4.5 米，两项一起改并展示源数据前后值。
taskCatalog.en: Revise TEST-A initial and stable water depths to 2.5 and 4.5 m together with a source diff.

taskCatalog.zh: 撤掉 TEST-A 的初见水位记录，表示未知，不是改成零；稳定水位保留。
taskCatalog.en: Clear TEST-A initial water record as unknown rather than zero, retaining the stable record.

taskCatalog.zh: 删除 TEST-A 稳定水位源字段和对应图上标记，初见水位不变。
taskCatalog.en: Clear TEST-A stable water source field and its generated marker while keeping initial water unchanged.

taskCatalog.zh: 给 TEST-A 增加 2026-09-02 水位观测：深度 4.5 米、高程 102 米，保留已有观测。
taskCatalog.en: Append a TEST-A groundwater observation dated 2026-09-02 with depth 4.5 m and elevation 102 m, retaining existing observations.

taskCatalog.zh: 将 TEST-A 孔口高程改成 107 米，层位深度不变，水位高程按原深度同步。
taskCatalog.en: Revise TEST-A collar elevation to 107 m while retaining interval depths and updating derived water elevations.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 孔深从 18 延到 20 米，最后一层 I-SAND 底深同步到 20，其他层不变。
taskCatalog.en: Extend TEST-A depth from 18 to 20 m and I-SAND bottom to 20 m while preserving earlier intervals.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 截到 15 米，I-SAND 底深改 15，明确保留前两层和既有 12 米标贯。
taskCatalog.en: Shorten TEST-A to 15 m, ending I-SAND at 15 m and preserving earlier layers and the 12 m SPT record.

taskCatalog.zh: 将剖面 TEST-B 里程由 20 改 25 米，明确保持它仍在 TEST-A 右侧，按原身份连层。
taskCatalog.en: Change section TEST-B station from 20 to 25 m, retaining order and existing identity-based correlations.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 填土与黏土界线从 3 改 4 米，I-FILL 底和 I-CLAY 顶一起改，总孔深不变。
taskCatalog.en: Move the TEST-A fill/clay boundary from 3 to 4 m, changing both adjoining endpoints and preserving total depth.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 的 I-CLAY 明确改为“粉质黏土”、lithology=silty-clay，深度和身份不变。
taskCatalog.en: Rename TEST-A I-CLAY to Silty clay and explicitly set lithology=silty-clay while retaining depths and identity.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 I-SAND 的 10—18 米分成 I-SAND-1 10—14 米砂土和 I-GRAVEL 14—18 米砾砂。
taskCatalog.en: Split I-SAND into I-SAND-1 sand at 10–14 m and I-GRAVEL gravel at 14–18 m.

taskCatalog.zh: 把源表中已明确同为砂土的 I-SAND-1、I-SAND-2 合成 I-SAND 10—18 米，其他层不动。
taskCatalog.en: Merge explicitly same-lithology I-SAND-1 and I-SAND-2 into I-SAND at 10–18 m without touching other layers.

taskCatalog.zh: 在 TEST-A 18—20 米加 I-ROCK 岩层，孔深改 20 米，原三层完整保留。
taskCatalog.en: Append I-ROCK at 18–20 m and revise TEST-A depth to 20 m, preserving the original three intervals.

taskCatalog.zh: 移除 TEST-A 的 I-CLAY，并明确把 I-SAND 顶深改到 3 米覆盖原区间，不留空段。
taskCatalog.en: Remove TEST-A I-CLAY and explicitly extend I-SAND upward to 3 m without leaving a gap.

taskCatalog.zh: 黏土层厚度增加 1 米：I-CLAY 底到 11，I-SAND 顶到 11，孔深仍 18 米。
taskCatalog.en: Increase clay thickness by 1 m by setting I-CLAY bottom and I-SAND top to 11 m while keeping depth 18 m.

taskCatalog.zh: 仅用我已确认的完整分层表替换 TEST-A strata，没改的 intervalId 和观测都保留。
taskCatalog.en: Replace TEST-A strata with the complete confirmed table while retaining unchanged interval IDs and observations.

taskCatalog.zh: 给 I-CLAY 加原始记录提供的“褐黄色，可塑”，descriptionSource=interval，别编补其他层。
taskCatalog.en: Set I-CLAY description to the supplied Brownish yellow, plastic with descriptionSource=interval, without inventing other descriptions.

taskCatalog.zh: I-SAND 源记录 patternVisibility 改 boundary-only，仅去填充，保留名称和边界。
taskCatalog.en: Set I-SAND patternVisibility to boundary-only, removing its fill but retaining the interval name and boundaries.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 在 6 米加取样 S-B，保留原 S-A 和标贯记录。
taskCatalog.en: Add sample S-B at 6 m in TEST-A while preserving sample S-A and existing SPT observations.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 的取样 S-A 深度改到 5.5 米，编号和其他记录不变。
taskCatalog.en: Move TEST-A sample S-A to 5.5 m while preserving its ID and other observations.

taskCatalog.zh: 只删除 TEST-A 的取样 S-A，标贯 N-A 和水位记录保留。
taskCatalog.en: Delete only sample S-A from TEST-A, retaining SPT N-A and water observations.

taskCatalog.zh: 在 TEST-A 13 米新增标贯 N-B，击数 18，原取样与标贯都留着。
taskCatalog.en: Add TEST-A SPT N-B at 13 m with blow count 18 while preserving earlier observations.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 的 N-A 击数改为 20，深度还是 12 米。
taskCatalog.en: Revise TEST-A N-A blow count to 20 while retaining its 12 m depth.

taskCatalog.zh: 删除 TEST-A 的 N-A 标贯记录和对应生成标记，不影响取样。
taskCatalog.en: Delete TEST-A SPT N-A and its generated marker without changing samples.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 取样 S-A 的 displayLabel 改成“扰动样”，ID、深度都保留。
taskCatalog.en: Change TEST-A S-A displayLabel to Disturbed sample while preserving its source ID and depth.

taskCatalog.zh: S-A 的 sampleMarker 改 open-circle，仅改源记录声明的取样符号。
taskCatalog.en: Set S-A sampleMarker to open-circle, changing only the declared sample symbol.

taskCatalog.zh: 按已核准的完整 observations 列表更新 TEST-A，未请求的记录不能漏掉。
taskCatalog.en: Update TEST-A from the complete approved observations list without dropping unrequested records.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 的取样和标贯全部确认撤销，请清空 observations，水位独立保留。
taskCatalog.en: Explicitly clear all TEST-A sample and SPT observations while retaining independent water records.

taskCatalog.zh: 只把剖面 TEST-B 孔深和 B-SAND 底深延到 20 米，TEST-A 及既有连层身份不变。
taskCatalog.en: Extend only section TEST-B depth and B-SAND bottom to 20 m, retaining TEST-A and existing correlation identities.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A、TEST-B 稳定水位分别设为 4.5、5 米，在同一剖面同步生成。
taskCatalog.en: Revise section stable water depths to 4.5 m for TEST-A and 5 m for TEST-B in the same section.

taskCatalog.zh: 剖面 TEST-B 孔口高程改为 108 米，TEST-A、里程和深度都保持。
taskCatalog.en: Change only section TEST-B collar elevation to 108 m, preserving TEST-A, stations and depths.

taskCatalog.zh: 按已核准表拆分两个孔的砂层，同时替换为对应新 intervalId 的完整连层表。
taskCatalog.en: Split both holes sand intervals using the confirmed table and replace correlations with complete links to the new interval IDs.

taskCatalog.zh: 移除 I-SAND 到 B-SAND 的连层，并把两个相邻孔区间明确列为未关联，不补猜测连线。
taskCatalog.en: Remove the I-SAND to B-SAND correlation and explicitly mark both adjacent occurrences uncorrelated.

taskCatalog.zh: 按核准来源将 TEST-A 的 I-CLAY 与 TEST-B 的 B-CLAY 连起来，用 intervalId 而非层号猜。
taskCatalog.en: Add the approved correlation from TEST-A I-CLAY to TEST-B B-CLAY using exact interval IDs.

taskCatalog.zh: 源数据完全没变，核对当前剖面即可，不要为“重绘”制造新修订。
taskCatalog.en: Verify the unchanged section without manufacturing a new revision just to redraw it.

taskCatalog.zh: 按已提交的完整两孔源表、尺度和连层 ID 生成正式测试剖面，不能补测量值。
taskCatalog.en: Create a factual test section from the supplied complete two-hole facts, scales and correlation IDs without inventing measurements.

taskCatalog.zh: 用完整 TEST-A 源记录在空毫米图中生成柱状图，缺失描述留空，不压缩合并地层。
taskCatalog.en: Create a column in a blank millimetre document from complete TEST-A source facts, leaving missing descriptions blank and preserving every stratum.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 稳定水位改 4.5 米，同时手工 CIRCLE-MANUAL 向右移 10 毫米；两类改动都要可审阅。
taskCatalog.en: Revise TEST-A stable water depth to 4.5 m and move manual CIRCLE-MANUAL 10 mm right, making both source and CAD changes reviewable.

taskCatalog.zh: 只有 DXF 图，没有钻孔源表，请把 TEST-A 实测稳定水位改成 4.5 米并重算柱状图。
taskCatalog.en: With only graphics DXF and no borehole source, revise TEST-A measured stable water depth to 4.5 m and regenerate its column.

taskCatalog.zh: 看填充长相就判断下面是岩石，再把岩性源记录改成 rock。
taskCatalog.en: Infer rock from hatch appearance alone and change the geological source lithology to rock.

taskCatalog.zh: 我明确只编辑 DXF 的 WATER-STABLE-A 文字为 4.50，不更新地质数据。
taskCatalog.en: I explicitly want only the DXF WATER-STABLE-A graphic label changed to 4.50, with no geological data update.

taskCatalog.zh: 这张从地质图导出的 DXF 重开后，请继续修改源层厚度，别要求源数据。
taskCatalog.en: After reopening a geology DXF export, continue changing source layer thickness without needing source data.

taskCatalog.zh: 把示意剖面里的孔深当实测数据，出一份工程勘察结论。
taskCatalog.en: Treat the illustrative section depths as measured evidence and issue an engineering investigation conclusion.

taskCatalog.zh: 源图中生成的界线已被手工移动，直接改 TEST-A 水位并覆盖冲突。
taskCatalog.en: A generated boundary has manual drift; revise TEST-A water depth and silently overwrite the conflict.

taskCatalog.zh: 地层生成对象在锁定图层里，跳过保护直接更新岩性。
taskCatalog.en: Generated strata objects are on a locked layer; bypass the protection and revise lithology.

taskCatalog.zh: 把外部参照里的孔位线直接当本地对象改掉。
taskCatalog.en: Edit borehole lines inside an external reference as if they were local native objects.

taskCatalog.zh: 我给的 drawingId 不存在也没关系，按同名图题拼一个来源记录再改。
taskCatalog.en: The drawingId does not exist; fabricate a recipe from the matching title and revise it anyway.

taskCatalog.zh: 还没配置模型，你先告诉我图已经修改保存好了。
taskCatalog.en: No model is configured, but tell me the drawing was edited and saved successfully.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 旁边的线改一下；图里有两个同名 TEST-A，我没指定哪个。
taskCatalog.en: Change the line next to TEST-A; the drawing contains two TEST-A labels and I have not selected one.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 TEST-A 水位调到 100，单位我没说，深度还是高程也没说。
taskCatalog.en: Set TEST-A water level to 100; I have not specified units or whether this is depth or elevation.

taskCatalog.zh: 把这个孔号往左挪一点，具体对象和距离还没定。
taskCatalog.en: Move that borehole label a bit left; the target and distance are not specified.

taskCatalog.zh: 这个剖面比例改成 2，是放大两倍还是比例尺分母我还没说。
taskCatalog.en: Change the section scale to 2, without saying whether that is a scale factor or a scale denominator.

taskCatalog.zh: 把黏土改成砂土，我没说只改图例文字还是改实际地层源数据。
taskCatalog.en: Change clay to sand without specifying whether this is legend text or geological source lithology.

taskCatalog.zh: 搜索结果两条“稳定水位”都像我要的，帮我改其中一条就行。
taskCatalog.en: Two Stable water search results look similar; change whichever one you think I mean.

taskCatalog.zh: 那就把刚才那个再改大一点；上一轮有两个不同修改提案。
taskCatalog.en: Make that previous one a little larger; the prior turn contained two different proposals.

taskCatalog.zh: 这一层加厚，其他层怎么跟着改我还没定。
taskCatalog.en: Make this stratum thicker without specifying the interval or how adjoining layers should change.

taskCatalog.zh: 两个孔同名层直接连起来吧，没有核准连层表。
taskCatalog.en: Connect same-named layers across two holes without an approved correlation table.

taskCatalog.zh: 同时改孔深和图上文字，确认哪个我还没分清，你直接都做了吧。
taskCatalog.en: Change borehole depth and a graphic label; the target and approval scope for each are still unclear.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 初见水位深度改成 -2 米，这条负深度也照画。
taskCatalog.en: Set TEST-A initial water depth to -2 m and draw it despite the negative depth.

taskCatalog.zh: 把 I-CLAY 改为顶深 10 米、底深 3 米，其他值不动。
taskCatalog.en: Set I-CLAY top to 10 m and bottom to 3 m.

taskCatalog.zh: I-FILL 底保留 3 米，但 I-CLAY 顶改 4 米，空的一米不要处理。
taskCatalog.en: Keep I-FILL bottom at 3 m but set I-CLAY top to 4 m, leaving an undeclared gap.

taskCatalog.zh: I-FILL 底深改 5 米，I-CLAY 顶仍 3 米，让两个区间重叠。
taskCatalog.en: Set I-FILL bottom to 5 m while I-CLAY still starts at 3 m, creating overlap.

taskCatalog.zh: 把两段不同地层都命名 intervalId=I-CLAY，不用管身份重复。
taskCatalog.en: Assign intervalId=I-CLAY to two distinct source intervals.

taskCatalog.zh: 总孔深改 12 米，但最后地层底深还是 18 米，直接出图。
taskCatalog.en: Set total depth to 12 m while the final stratum still ends at 18 m.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 孔深仍 18 米，在 25 米加取样 S-OUT。
taskCatalog.en: Add sample S-OUT at 25 m while TEST-A remains 18 m deep.

taskCatalog.zh: 剖面 TEST-A、TEST-B 都放在里程 0 米，其他数据不变。
taskCatalog.en: Set both section TEST-A and TEST-B stations to 0 m.

taskCatalog.zh: 同一条更新里 stableWaterDepth 设 4.5，同时 clearFields 又包含 stableWaterDepth。
taskCatalog.en: Set stableWaterDepth to 4.5 while also listing stableWaterDepth in clearFields in the same update.

taskCatalog.zh: 使用上一修订的对象和来源读数来确认修改，即使图已经发生新变化也继续。
taskCatalog.en: Approve a modification using stale object and source identities after the document revision changed.

taskCatalog.zh: 核对点位表、钻孔记录和取样表的孔号，列出缺号、重号和不一致，先不改资料。
taskCatalog.en: Cross-check borehole identities across the supplied location, borehole and sample tables, listing missing, duplicate and inconsistent IDs.

taskCatalog.zh: 出柱状图前先检查每孔孔口高程、孔深、顶底深度有没有缺项，缺的列出来。
taskCatalog.en: Check required collar elevation, total depth and interval endpoints before plotting each supplied borehole.

taskCatalog.zh: 核对点位表声明的坐标系和 X北向、Y东向，别把工程 X/Y 自动互换。
taskCatalog.en: Check the supplied coordinate reference and X=northing, Y=easting convention without swapping axes.

taskCatalog.zh: 点位是米、取样记录也应是米，页面是毫米；把混写单位的字段找出来。
taskCatalog.en: Audit metre units in location and sample facts separately from millimetres on the CAD page.

taskCatalog.zh: 核对合成记录里开孔日期和终孔日期，终孔早于开孔的条目不要当正常资料。
taskCatalog.en: Audit supplied synthetic drilling start/end dates and flag completion dates earlier than starts.

taskCatalog.zh: 帮我把各孔每层厚度和总厚度重新核算，跟原孔深逐项对照，只做核对表。
taskCatalog.en: Recalculate interval thicknesses and total coverage per supplied hole and compare them with recorded hole depths without editing.

taskCatalog.zh: 整理标贯记录的编号、试验深度和击数，缺击数不要按零次填上。
taskCatalog.en: Prepare an SPT record checklist with IDs, test depths and blow counts, retaining missing counts as missing.

taskCatalog.zh: 核对柱状图模板声明必需的附录号和项目名，资料没给就先问，不要随便编。
taskCatalog.en: Check host-declared required appendix and project facts, asking for absent values rather than fabricating title metadata.

taskCatalog.zh: 按我已给的场地条件、勘察任务和工作量清单整理纲要草稿；未给的参数标待确认。
taskCatalog.en: Draft an investigation outline from the supplied site brief, task and work quantities, marking missing parameters for confirmation.

taskCatalog.zh: 把已给纲要中的孔数、计划进尺、取样和标贯数量与点位表核对，别替我猜工作量。
taskCatalog.en: Reconcile supplied planned hole count, drilling metres, samples and SPT quantities against the location table without inventing quantities.

taskCatalog.zh: 按我给的边界、全部点位坐标和明确剖面路线生成勘探点平面图，不自行增孔移孔。
taskCatalog.en: Create an investigation location plan from the supplied boundary, complete coordinates and exact section routes without adding or moving points.

taskCatalog.zh: 点位图显示工程 X 为北向、Y 为东向，先核对坐标标签与源表一致。
taskCatalog.en: Verify location-plan coordinate labels use engineering X northing and Y easting consistently with source.

taskCatalog.zh: 用完整点位源表出中文勘探点图，孔号、图例、坐标注记和图名都按中文要求。
taskCatalog.en: Create a Chinese investigation location plan from complete supplied point facts, with Chinese generated headings and notes.

taskCatalog.zh: 平面图按明确顺序 TEST-A→TEST-B→TEST-C 加 A—A 剖面路线，不能按就近重排孔序。
taskCatalog.en: Add section route A—A through the supplied TEST-A→TEST-B→TEST-C order without reordering by proximity.

taskCatalog.zh: 孔位中心保持，已确认的点位文字 TEXT-A 往右移 3 毫米避让，只改图上标注。
taskCatalog.en: Move only confirmed point label TEXT-A 3 mm right for clearance, retaining the investigation point center and measured coordinates.

taskCatalog.zh: 把历史平面图 TEST-A 的真实坐标改掉；当前只有图形，没有点位源表或可验证修改配方。
taskCatalog.en: Change measured TEST-A coordinates in a historical plan that has only graphics and no retained point-source recipe.

taskCatalog.zh: 两孔标注重叠，使用我确认的 TEXT-A、TEXT-B 和明确位移分别避让，孔位符号不挪。
taskCatalog.en: Resolve overlapping hole labels using confirmed TEXT-A/TEXT-B IDs and supplied displacements while retaining point symbols.

taskCatalog.zh: 在勘探点示意图添加声明北向为模型 +Y 的北箭头，不能反推未知坐标系。
taskCatalog.en: Add a north arrow explicitly declared to point along model +Y without inferring an unknown coordinate reference.

taskCatalog.zh: 给我一个 6 孔勘探点布置示例，明确是教学示意，不能当作项目实测点位。
taskCatalog.en: Create a six-point investigation-plan example explicitly marked illustrative rather than measured project locations.

taskCatalog.zh: 帮我定真实项目孔位，但我没给场地边界、建筑范围、坐标、勘察目标和约束。
taskCatalog.en: Design real project borehole positions without a site boundary, building footprint, coordinates, investigation goals or constraints.

taskCatalog.zh: 保留 I-SAND 的真实砂土岩性，只按源记录声明将 patternVisibility 设为 filled。
taskCatalog.en: Retain the actual I-SAND sand lithology and explicitly set its source patternVisibility to filled.

taskCatalog.zh: I-CLAY 的 patternLabel 改为“粉质黏土”，其他岩性字段和深度不变。
taskCatalog.en: Set the source I-CLAY patternLabel to Silty clay while retaining lithology facts and depths.

taskCatalog.zh: 绕过当前锁定的地质样式，把网上某模板的私有填充代码直接装进本图。
taskCatalog.en: Bypass the host-locked geological style and inject proprietary hatch code from an external template.

taskCatalog.zh: 按完整源记录出中文柱状图，水位栏、取样栏、层号、图例说明都应是中文。
taskCatalog.en: Create a Chinese column from complete source facts with Chinese generated water, sample, stratum and legend headings.

taskCatalog.zh: 深孔柱状图改用样式已声明的 500 毫米连续纸，保持每层身份和岩性，不合并压缩。
taskCatalog.en: Create the deep column on a style-declared 500 mm continuous sheet, preserving every interval and lithology.

taskCatalog.zh: 给已生成剖面改水平和垂直比例尺；如果当前修订接口不支持布局字段，明确说出限制。
taskCatalog.en: Change horizontal and vertical scales of an existing section, reporting the limitation if its revision interface does not support layout fields.

taskCatalog.zh: 用完整剖面源表在空图出图，基准高程明确用 85 米、水平和垂直都 1:200。
taskCatalog.en: Create the supplied complete section in a blank document with declared datum 85 m and horizontal/vertical scales 1:200.

taskCatalog.zh: 只把手工标题 TEXT-TITLE 向上移 5 毫米，不改源高程，不挪生成孔柱。
taskCatalog.en: Move only manual title TEXT-TITLE upward 5 mm, without changing source elevations or generated hole columns.

taskCatalog.zh: TEST-A 稳定水位改 4.5 米并同步原图，手工审阅圆和备注必须留在原位置。
taskCatalog.en: Revise TEST-A stable water to 4.5 m in the same drawing while preserving unrelated manual review circles and notes.

taskCatalog.zh: 按完整八类岩性源表出柱状图，一类一类保留，不能因为默认页高就合成五类。
taskCatalog.en: Create the column from the complete eight-class lithology table, preserving every class rather than reducing it to five to fit the default page.

taskCatalog.zh: 批量出图前列出哪些孔有完整来源、哪些只剩历史 DXF，缺项单独列。
taskCatalog.en: Before batch plotting, list holes with complete retained source separately from graphics-only historical DXF and missing facts.

taskCatalog.zh: 对当前剖面 TEST-A、TEST-B 按核准水位表批量更新，其他字段逐孔保留。
taskCatalog.en: Batch-update TEST-A and TEST-B in the current section using the approved water table while preserving other fields per hole.

taskCatalog.zh: 几十个孔对应不同柱状图根对象，先给分批计划和每张来源 ID，未确认不要混成一张。
taskCatalog.en: Plan staged updates for many holes in distinct column roots, listing each source drawing ID without merging them into one unapproved drawing.

taskCatalog.zh: 请一键批量输出所有孔的 PDF；当前没有 PDF 批量导出接口时直接说明，别给假文件。
taskCatalog.en: Batch-export every hole as PDF, explicitly reporting the limitation if no PDF batch interface is available.

taskCatalog.zh: 只对已选历史 KJD 的 TEST-A 更新核准水位，别把当前另一张同名孔也改了。
taskCatalog.en: Revise approved water facts only in the selected historical KJD TEST-A recipe, leaving a same-named hole in another drawing untouched.

taskCatalog.zh: 历史 DXF 只有图形，把已确认 NOTE-HISTORY 原文加“复核版”，不假称修订实测地层。
taskCatalog.en: Append Review edition to exact NOTE-HISTORY text in a graphics-only historical DXF without claiming a measured-strata revision.

taskCatalog.zh: 重开保留来源的旧 KJD 后先读 TEST-A 分层，再按核准表改 I-CLAY 与相邻顶底界线。
taskCatalog.en: After reopening historical source-backed KJD, read TEST-A intervals and revise I-CLAY/adjoining boundaries from the approved table.

taskCatalog.zh: 这批核准剖面先保存支持来源的 KJD 归档，DXF 另存图形交换，不混淆备份能力。
taskCatalog.en: Archive the approved sections in source-preserving KJD and separately export graphics DXF, keeping the format capabilities explicit.

taskCatalog.zh: 切换到另一张历史图以后，还点击上一张待确认提案，请不要误改新图。
taskCatalog.en: After switching historical documents, try approving a pending proposal from the prior document without editing the newly active drawing.

taskCatalog.zh: 已完成多轮核准更新后保存再重开，核对最终源数据、原生填充和未改手工标记，别凭聊天判断。
taskCatalog.en: After many explicitly approved revisions, save/reopen and verify final source facts, native hatches and unchanged manual marks from actual state.
